notes.title: Mind Trap Season One - Airing Now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35259784/8c85fc4d4e06e86070432bd9a05f3ea02ed4dc4b.png[/img]

Hello All;

I am so very excited to announce that episode one is OUT NOW on steam!

So what does this mean?

Well now that episode one is out the door I can continue to work on episode two, which as an early access supporter you will get for free in an upcoming update! I will have something awesome to show very soon! I can't wait to get the next 3 episodes in your hands.

As a solo dev this is a daunting task to say the least, however I am more than up to the challenge. So with that said thanks for your support!

More news coming at you very soon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35259784/25176cd23c439d71c0296b2b40d9695f746197be.png[/img]

notes.title: All new media & Release date news!
notes.notes:
Hello All;

I am very excited and pleased to announce that development on Episode One: Denial is COMPLETE! It is in the final phase of testing now.

I have replaced all the still media with new images from the final build of the game.

The games release date is coming very soon. (Less than a month away!) 

I have also cracked into episode two which will be announced and showcased shortly after the release of episode one. So please when released jump on board and get episode one with episodes 2,3,4 to follow in updates!

Thanks so much for reading!

- The Dev

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35259784/25176cd23c439d71c0296b2b40d9695f746197be.png[/img]

notes.title: Voice Cast - Amazing Talent for Episode One
notes.notes:
I am super pumped and pleased to announce that I landed some AMAZING voice talent for the first episode of Mind Trap: Denial

Melissa Sheldon As Sara Davis
Steve McGrath As Dr. Markem
Katie Otten As Sally Jenkins 
Jonas Faes As TV Host / Narrator

I could not be happier with the enthusiasm and vocal chops shown by these awesome people. Thanks so much!

More game news coming soon!

Thanks for reading!
